The National Institute for Reproductive Health (NIRH) and the National Institute for Reproductive Health Action Fund (NIRH Action Fund), advocacy groups that fight for just and equitable access to reproductive health care, are seeking a full-time Director of Policy and Research to help them in building political power for reproductive freedom.

WHO WE ARE
The National Institute for Reproductive Health (NIRH) and the National Institute for Reproductive Health Action Fund (NIRH Action Fund) are advocacy groups that fight for just and equitable access to reproductive health care and build political power for reproductive freedom. For decades, our strategy has been to go on the offensive, at the state and local level, so we have a long track record of passing laws that are safeguarding and advancing access.
In states and cities across the country, we launch campaigns, change policy, and elect candidates who champion our cause, all by working hand-in-hand with reproductive health, rights, and justice organizations; health care providers; and other groups invested in this fight. Why We Exist
Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry is building the first app to manage it all.

Why We're Hiring
The next frontier is helping people with the cost of owning a home. Property tax appeals is one of the first offerings we're building - and the Florida appeals season is starting.
This is a domain where being 90% right isn’t going to cut it. Florida's Value Adjustment Board process has a 25-day filing window, a partial-payment requirement that silently kills otherwise-valid petitions, and 67 counties that each run the process differently. Before a single homeowner's petition depends on what we build, we need someone who has lived inside that system to pressure-test it.
This is a deliberately narrow engagement - a few hours a week from someone excellent. The work is advisory: reviewing what we build, flagging what won't survive contact with the VAB, and telling us when we're wrong before it costs a customer.
Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

• Hourly, as-needed : This is an independent contractor engagement at roughly 5-10 hours per week with no fixed schedule. If this product starts to see traction, there is a path to a full-time permanent role if you’re interested.

• Early-stage product : You are advising on a new product. The customer flows, backend authorization flows, and filing logic is still being shaped. Your job is to help guide our design and help correct things before we push it to production.

What You'll Own

• Regulatory grounding : Clarify how things like Chapter 194, F.S. and the DOR uniform rules (12D-9, 12D-10) operate in practice and not only how they read on paper.

• County-level reality : Walk us through how the Property Appraiser's offices and VABs actually differ across the volume counties: Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Hillsborough, Orange, Duval, Pinellas, and Lee.

• Filing mechanics : TRIM notice timing, the 25-day window, DR-486 and its variants, e-filing versus paper, and the §194.014 partial-payment requirement - guide us through the process.

• Hearings and evidence : Help build a flow that actually wins in front of a special magistrate - comparable selection, the 15-day and 7-day evidence exchange windows, and condition-based arguments.

Who You Are

• Built inside the VAB system : You can describe why Broward is different from Hillsborough without looking it up. Your knowledge was built through filings or arguing petitions, not advising on property tax from a distance.

• Volume-tested : You've worked across hundreds of parcels and seen enough edge cases that you recognize the pattern before it becomes a problem.

• Procedurally sharp : You know every step of the appeals process as if it was the back of your hand.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of direct, hands-on Florida experience filing residential property tax appeals.

• Personal experience filing or arguing petitions before a Florida VAB, or adjudicating them as a special magistrate.

• No active conflict: not currently advising another company building consumer property tax appeal software.

• Florida-based strongly preferred, given county-level familiarity requirements.

Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain ’s platform.

What We Need
NetBrain is in a growth phase, and that includes the People Experience team. This is a newly created role designed to allow HR leadership and our Business Partners to focus on their specialty areas rather than carrying a broad operational scope.
We need a dedicated owner for the operational engine of People Experience, someone who can build and manage the systems, programs, and processes that keep HR running accurately and compliantly at scale. This includes owning HRIS, comp and merit cycles, lifecycle processes, compliance, and HR analytics, with benefits oversight as part of the portfolio.
If you are energized by building structure in ambiguous environments, have a strong command of HR systems and total rewards, and want to own the infrastructure that powers People Experience at a PE-backed tech company, this is the role for you!
What You'll Do
Systems & Analytics

• Own HRIS administration across our people systems (ATS, People Management, HRIS) ensuring data integrity, workflow efficiency, and system integrations are maintained

• Lead data governance across people systems, clean data, accurate reporting, and a single source of truth for headcount and compensation

• Continue to build and maintain our existing job architecture, leveling frameworks, job codes, and consistency across the org

• Design and deliver people analytics dashboards for the Board, ELT, and People team, covering headcount, attrition, comp, and hiring metrics

• Partner with the VP of People to build and manage HR/AI workflows to automate and streamline operational HR processes

Lifecycle & Compliance

• Own end-to-end onboarding and offboarding, creating a consistent and welcoming experience for every new hire and a respectful, organized process for every departure

• Manage US-federal compliance filings and training, including multi-state requirements and the annual global compliance calendar

• Own the People inbox and HR communications, ensuring employees and managers get accurate, timely responses

• Maintain and update HR policies as the company evolves in partnership with Legal

Total Rewards Administration

• Administer compensation programs for global employees including Sales, managing comp changes, equity tracking, and cycle execution

• Own bonus and merit-cycle administration from planning through payout, including data integrity and manager communications

• Oversee the Benefits Partner who handles benefits administration, carrier relationships, open enrollment, leave administration, and employee questions

• Manage equity tracking and administration in partnership with Legal & Finance

• Build and run employee recognition programs that reinforce culture and performance with support from the People Business Partners

What You Bring
Required

• 8+ years of progressive HR operations and/or total rewards experience with meaningful ownership of total reward programs

• Hands-on HRIS and ATS administration experience; led RFP process and implementation for new HRIS vendor

• Strong comp fundamentals: salary benchmarking, merit cycles, sales incentives, bonus administration, and internal equity

• Experience building or maintaining job architecture and leveling frameworks

• Federal and multi-state US compliance knowledge and you know what you don't know and when to escalate appropriately

• Data-driven mindset; you build dashboards and reports people actually use

• Comfort operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

• Located or able to work central or eastern time

title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our team and culture make us unique - we’re driven by impact and growth, where every one of us strives to learn and excel. Recognised by Sifted’s Rising 100 https://sifted.eu/rankings/b2b-saas-rising-100-2024 and LinkedIn's Top Startups https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-20-aufstrebende-unternehmen-bjd0c/, we’re here to help propel your career and together, make Moss a lasting success.

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

Your responsibilities

- Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down.

- Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy.

- Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it.

- Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently.

- Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling

- Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale.

About you

- Proven experience in a deal desk, pricing, commercial, revenue operations, or sales-strategy role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience standing up or scaling a deal desk or pricing process from scratch is a plus.

- Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling.

- The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last

- Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

- Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team.

- A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job.

- Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments.

- Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment.

- Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 5,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, Gusto and Auto1, Moss has raised €200+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets.
